ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-2
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-G in
the area bounded by:

      a line 100 feet south of and parallel to West Winona Street; a line 135 feet west of and
      parallel to North Broadway Avenue; a line 250 feet south of and parallel to West Winona
      Street; and North Broadway Avenue,

to those of a C1-5, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                         ____________________________
                                                         Leni Manaa-Hoppenworth
                                                         Alderwoman, 48th Ward



Common Addresses:
5067-5069 N. Broadway Avenue
